verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSMs (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, OTP, and the NetHSM appliance). Generating AI insights from user data inside the product is a category error for devices that exist to protect keys and credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey ships any AI insight capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
